candidates.title: SparseServe: Unlocking Parallelism for Dynamic Sparse Attention in Long-Context LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Hierarchical HBM-DRAM KV management for dynamic sparse attention with GPU-direct fragmented loading, working-set-aware batching and layer-segmented prefill; reports up to 9.26x lower mean TTFT and 3.14x higher token throughput.

candidates.title: SparDA: Sparse Decoupled Attention for Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Decoupled sparse-attention architecture predicts next-layer KV blocks to overlap CPU-to-GPU prefetch with current execution; reports up to 1.7x decode speedup and 5.3x higher decode throughput than non-offload sparse baseline, with released code.

discovery_stats.axis: long-context sparse attention・HBM/DRAM KV offload・lookahead prefetch
discovery_stats.query_summary: serverless cold-startからlong-context sparse-attention offloadへ切り替えた。SparseServeとSparDAはいずれも階層メモリ/転送を中心とするsystems寄与と実測評価を持ち、canonical ID/titleをdefault branchで再検索して未収録を確認した。
